mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_ticket_waitlist WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM tb_ticket_waitlist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND active_flag = 1
SELECT DISTINCT ticket_id FROM tb_ticket_waitlist WHERE status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY ticket_id
mapper.sql: w.id, w.ticket_id, t.title AS ticket_title, w.status, w.price, w.use_credits, w.failure_reason, w.reservation_id, w.create_time, o.id AS order_id, o.status AS order_status, DATE_ADD(o.create_time, INTERVAL #{timeoutSeconds} SECOND) AS payment_deadline, CASE WHEN w.status IN (0, 1) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM tb_ticket_waitlist ahead WHERE ahead.ticket_id = w.ticket_id AND ahead.status IN (0, 1) AND ahead.id < w.id) ELSE NULL END AS position
tb_ticket_waitlist w LEFT JOIN tb_ticket t ON t.id = w.ticket_id LEFT JOIN tb_ticket_reservation r ON r.id = w.reservation_id LEFT JOIN tb_ticket_order o ON o.id = r.order_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.id DESC
SELECT FROM WHERE w.id = #{id} AND w.user_id = #{userId}
